name: qkd_sessions
description: One row per settling period of a decoy-state BB84 link: the observables the two ends publish, the operator's thermometer, and the event class that was running. Columns prefixed true_ are for evaluation only.

columns.time_s: seconds since the start of the episode
columns.label: event class, the classification target
columns.onset_s: when the event started; NaN for an event-free episode
columns.active: 1 while the event is actually running, 0 before and between bursts
columns.strength: severity in force this period, 0 to 1 (ramped and intermittent events)
columns.signal_error: error rate among signal clicks, E_mu
columns.decoy_error: error rate among decoy clicks, E_nu
columns.signal_intensity: mean photon number of the signal state
columns.decoy_intensity: mean photon number of the weak decoy state
columns.single_photon_yield_lower: Y_1 lower bound from the decoy analysis
columns.single_photon_error_upper: e_1 upper bound from the decoy analysis
columns.key_rate_hz: secret key rate implied by this period's observables
columns.temperature_c: cable temperature, from the operator's sensor
columns.expected_gain: signal gain the commissioning calibration predicts
columns.true_misalignment: optical misalignment actually in force (not a feature)
columns.true_transmittance: channel transmittance actually in force (not a feature)
columns.true_single_photon_yield: Y_1 actually in force (not a feature)
columns.severity: the drawn magnitude of the event, in its own units
columns.profile: how the event arrives: step, ramp or intermittent
columns.thermal_cooccurrence: kelvin of simultaneous temperature excursion; 0 if none
